privates.description: Owned by the Luka, which starts with $200. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Public Line Bond

privates.name: Ganz Locomotive Works
privates.description: May be sold to any company for $1–100. That company may close it during its turn to buy a train from the supply. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Sava River Bridge
privates.description: Blocks L6. May be exchanged for a Shortline share in a stock round. Exchanged at the first 4+.

privates.name: Pazin Tunnel Company
privates.description: May be exchanged for a Shortline share in a stock round. Exchanged at the first 4+.

privates.name: Zadar Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Zadar. From 4H, may be sold to a company for $25–50. That company may lay or upgrade Zadar as its first tile lay, with no connection, then place a station there free. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Virovitica Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Virovitica. From 4H, may be sold to a company for $25–50. That company may lay or upgrade Virovitica as its first tile lay, with no connection, then place a station there free. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Rijeka Lazaretto
privates.description: During the OR of a company you preside, close this to put a quarantine marker on one of its trains. When that train would rust, it runs one more OR, then is discarded. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Kvarner Shipbuilding
privates.description: May be exchanged for a Shortline share in a stock round. Exchanged at the first 4+.

privates.name: Lika Survey Office
privates.description: Holds tile G2, a gray city. From the Diesel, a company you preside may lay it on any brown city but Karlovac as its upgrade. Never closes.

privates.name: Slavonian Agricultural Society
privates.description: Comes with a Mainline share. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Wiener Neustadt Locomotive Works
privates.description: From 4H, may be sold to a non-Luka company for $1–200. That company may close it during its turn to buy a train from the supply. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Kupa Steam Ferry
privates.description: Comes with a Mainline share. Closes at the first 4+.

privates.name: Austrian Bank
privates.description: Comes with a Mainline share and a random Luka-company share. Once per SR, the owner may buy one certificate or start a company for it, paying what it can't. Never sells or closes.

privates.name: Narodna Concession
privates.description: Comes with the Public Line president's certificate. Closes when the Public Line first operates.

privates.name: Hungarian Bank
privates.description: Comes with a Public Line share; works like the Austrian Bank. Until the first 2+, may convert to Ganz in a stock round: its cash and shares go to the owner, who sells down to the limits.

privates.name: MÁV Concession
privates.description: Comes with the Mainline president's certificate. Closes when the Mainline first operates.

privates.name: Südbahn Concession
privates.description: Comes with the Shortline president's certificate. Closes when the Shortline first operates.

privates.name: Ancona Steamship
privates.description: From 4H, may be sold to a non-Luka company for $45–90. That company places a free extra station on Ancona, and its routes to Ancona add the largest other stop for the rest of the game. Closes when sold or at the first 4+.

trains.description: Runs once more after the Diesel

turns.name: Stock Round
steps: Sell (at most 30% of one company per turn)
One action: buy, start a Luka company (or a Branch in the Late space), split, or act for the Austrian Bank or Hungarian Bank
optional: Free: private exchanges, Hungarian Bank conversion (until 2+)

phases.notes: Public Line Bonds may be exchanged
Hungarian Bank can no longer convert
